title: Dialog
description: A 448px task over the page on the ui-sdk Dialog part. It opens at once, traps focus and returns it.

<script setup lang="ts">

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]; showClose?: boolean }>(), { showClose: true });
